description: Marlim3 is Petrobras’s one-dimensional multiphase drift-flux simulator for production and injection systems. It supports steady and transient wells and networks, with thermal, fluid and artificial-lift models. The provider is Petrobras. Coverage: The software is generic, not a measured geographic dataset. Spatial detail and simulation periods are supplied by the user. Access: The public source repository provides documentation and installation instructions. Source archives and dependencies were not downloaded or run. Licence and cost: The repository identifies Apache 2.0. External dependencies and model-input rights require separate checks. Limitations: The maintainers report a major architectural refactoring and deferred bug fixes while reference cases are consolidated. Some documentation remains in Portuguese; numerical behaviour was not tested. For simulation it provides well and pipe-network flow calculations for production and injection studies. Related resources: No related catalogue record was established as an input, dependency or companion from the provider metadata.
